name: Community Centres
shortDescription: A directory of community centres across South Australia offering group activities focused on inclusion, wellbeing and social support.
plainEnglishSummary: If you want to meet people, join local activities or find social support near you, this directory can help you find your nearest community centre.
audience: South Australians looking for local community activities
People seeking social connection and community participation
People looking for nearby wellbeing or social support activities
availabilityNote: Activities, opening hours, accessibility and fees vary between community centres. Contact the selected centre before attending.
eligibilityNote: Community Connect cannot confirm whether a particular activity is available or suitable. Contact the selected community centre to confirm its programs, accessibility, availability and any fees.
